data.name: Tranquility
data.description: Psychic magic flows through you when you attain a peaceful mental state. Regular meditation expands your mind, allowing new powers to develop. Phrenic Pool Ability: Wisdom. Discipline Powers: Your stable mind protects you and your allies.
